detail.longDescription:
Grabnix - AI Core is an AI assistant app designed to help you create, organize, and manage smart AI-powered workflows directly from your device.

Build your own AI assistant, ask questions, generate ideas, automate routine tasks, and keep your conversations saved in one place. Grabnix - AI Core helps you work faster, stay organized, and turn your ideas into structured results.

With Grabnix - AI Core, you can:

Create your own AI assistant
Set up an assistant for your personal or professional tasks.

Automate your workflow
Use AI to support planning, writing, brainstorming, task organization, and productivity.

Ask anything and get answers
Use the chat interface to ask questions, generate content, or receive clear responses for your tasks.

Save every idea
Keep your chat history organized and return to previous conversations whenever you need them.

Control your AI experience
Rename, manage, and delete chats to keep your workspace clean and convenient.

Grabnix - AI Core is useful for creators, students, professionals, entrepreneurs, and anyone who wants a simple AI workspace for daily tasks and ideas.

Subscription Information

Subscription Payment:
Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and at the beginning of each renewal period. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled.

Subscription Cancellation:
You can cancel your subscription in your iTunes settings at least 24 hours before the end of the next subscription cycle. Cancellation will take effect on the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free version of the service.
